items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Was Joe or Leon -- was Leon Henderson around? Joe must have come later.

ctx.x: But my generation was Barry, Tommy Flanagan, and Kenny Burrell. There were others that were older.
Was Joe or Leon -- was Leon Henderson around? Joe must have come later. Leon’s his brother -- Leon.
Yeah, they did come later. Leon, yeah.
